title: Which Months of the Opening Benefit Period the First Allowance Covers
content:
Where a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card is brought into use, the months of the opening benefit period the allowance covers are counted from the opening day or from the day the card came into use, according to whether that period has already ended.

**The rule.** The months of the opening period the allowance covers are the whole months of that period that were still to run on the day the programme opened, where the card is brought into use after that period has ended; they are the whole months of that period still to run on the day the card is brought into use, where the card is brought into use inside that same period; and they are the whole of a benefit period in every other case.

**How the periods are told apart.** The benefit period the programme opened in is found by counting the whole months from the first day of the benefit year to the day the programme opened, and dividing by the months in a benefit period. The period the card is being brought into use in is found the same way, counting to the day the reckoning is made. Where the second falls later than the first, the opening period has ended.

| The opening period against the period the card comes into use in | The months the allowance covers |
|---|---|
| the card comes into use in a later period, the opening period having ended | the whole months of the opening period that were still to run on the day the programme opened |
| the card comes into use inside the opening period itself | the whole months of that period still to run on the day the card is brought into use |
| any other case | the whole of a benefit period |

**Worked through on hypothetical dates.** On a card whose benefit period runs 3 months, a programme opened 1 whole month into its opening period and brought into use in a later period: the months still to run on the opening day were 2, and the allowance covers 2 months. The same programme brought into use inside its opening period, 2 whole months into that period: the allowance covers 1 month, being what was still to run on the day it came into use.
